title: I Posted the Cold-Room Cleanout Photo That Was Only My Reagents

parts.text: I opened the cold room at 9:03 a.m. after a cleanout notice. Only my labeled reagent shelf was empty. The PI's unlabeled cake remained. The SOP said: CLEANOUT MEANS ALL EXPIRED, NOT ONE NAME. I was twenty-five, tech, holding a warm enzyme box. I photographed the cake, the SOP, and my empty tape. I posted the still on the lab Slack the PI moderated. The reagents were in a warm bin they had "set aside." They went back on ice. The cake went to the break room. SOP finally means all.

social.video_title: Cleanout meant only my reagent shelf — Part 1/1
social.description: Warm enzymes, PI cake, an SOP about all expired. Slack got the still. Has a cleanout ever had a favorite?
